subject_name: Understanding Data: Linear Regression Models for Interpretation and Prediction
content:
[37013 Understanding Data: Linear Regression Models for Interpretation and Prediction | Subject description]
Credit points: 2

This subject introduces linear regression as a tool to model the relationship between a continuous response variable and predictor variables, preparing you for advanced data modelling. It involves modelling data with lines, curves, or surfaces to best fit the observed patterns, accommodating both continuous and categorical predictors. You will learn to evaluate the model's fit to the data and verify the assumptions underpinning the modelling process.

subject_name: Understanding Data: Linear Regression Models for Interpretation and Prediction
content:
[37013 Understanding Data: Linear Regression Models for Interpretation and Prediction | Learning and teaching activities]
This subject will be presented in online mode and will run over 4 weeks. Theoretical material will be presented in the lecture and students will work on practical problems during the PC labs using the R programming language. To ensure maximum flexibility for participants working full time, the lectures and PC labs will be pre-recorded in MP4 screencast format for study at a suitable time.

 Classes will consist of 4 weekly 2-hour lectures and 4 weekly 1.5-hour PC labs. In addition to the weekly scheduled class time of 3.5 hours, students will require an additional 3.5 hours of independent study and 1 hour spent completing the weekly lab worksheet. A further 8 hours will be required to complete the data analysis assignment. This is roughly one-third of the requirements for a 6 credit point subject.

 In each weekly PC lab, students will be provided with a data set and a list of questions. Students will use R to process this data set and answer these questions, submitting their work after the lab. Their submissions will be marked and returned with written feedback prior to the following week’s lab. Students are encouraged to seek extra feedback where that might clarify issues arising from their work.

subject_name: Understanding Data: Linear Regression Models for Interpretation and Prediction
title: Learning outcomes
content:
[37013 Understanding Data: Linear Regression Models for Interpretation and Prediction | Learning outcomes]
SLO1: formulate relevant hypotheses and design appropriate experiments and data collection plans to test those hypotheses
SLO2: apply univariate and multivariate statistical data analysis methodology to hypothesis testing and experimentation
SLO3: implement statistical analysis methodology in R programming language
SLO4: communicate analysis results and conclusions clearly
